name: structAppend
description: Appends all the data from struct2 into struct2, replacing duplicate keys unless specified by the overwrite flag
syntax: structAppend( struct Struct1, struct Struct2, [boolean OverwriteFlag] )

params.name: Struct1
params.description: Structure to which struct2 is appended.

params.name: Struct2
params.description: Structure that contains the data to append to struct1

params.name: OverwriteFlag
params.description: - true (default): values in struct2 overwrite corresponding values in struct1.
